Maria (Solutions): Heads up — Acme asked for a full evidence bundle: ephemeral key rotation, KMS envelope wrapping details, RBAC mapping + audit proofs. We have a review call tomorrow 11am. Need a short plan.
Elaine (Sec): Thanks. Can we enumerate exactly what they want? I think they asked for: key rotation logs, KMS audit trail exports, service-account -> role mapping, and incident response runbook examples.
Jordan (Infra): I can export KMS audit logs (CloudTrail) and the key-state transitions. Need the time window — last 12 months? Also can pull envelope rewrap events.
Sam (Eng): For RBAC we can provide role->permission matrices and an audit of role changes. We rolled out ephemeral role leases in prod last quarter; we should include lease TTLs and the code path for issuance.
Alex (SRE): Also include alerting playbooks and at least two executed incident traces for correlation. Will we share unredacted traces? Legal will probably want PII redacted.
Maria (Solutions): Customer explicitly requested unredacted UIDs for correlation. Legal said we should avoid sharing PII and instead provide a mapping under NDA. Thoughts?
Elaine (Sec): Provide hashed IDs and offer a signed mapping under NDA. That’s standard. I’ll loop Legal for signoff.
Jordan (Infra): Regarding KMS architecture question: yes — we use envelope encryption. Data keys (DEKs) are generated per-asset, wrapped with CMKs. For Private/Dedicated customers we support customer-managed keys (BYOK). Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys unless customer requests otherwise.
Sam (Eng): Add that to the response: two flows (hosted vs customer-managed). Also mention rotation cadence and rewrap behavior.
Maria (Solutions): Can someone draft the KMS evidence snippet? i.e., "We rotate CMKs annually; DEKs are rewrapped on rotation; rotation events are recorded in audit logs" — short, verifiable statements.
Elaine (Sec): I'll draft. Jordan — can you provide a sanitized sample export command and a small redacted log sample we can paste?
Jordan (Infra): Yep, sample export command: `gcloud logging read 'logName="projects/REDACTED/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access" AND protoPayload.methodName:"CryptoKeyVersion"' --limit 100`
Jordan (Infra): Example redacted log line (sanitized):
```
protoPayload: {
  methodName: "v1.cryptoKeys.encrypt",
  resourceName: "projects/REDACTED/locations/global/keyRings/rr-key/cryptoKeys/rr-cmk",
  authenticationInfo: { principalEmail: "service-account@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com" }
}
```
Sam (Eng): For RBAC evidence include: role definition export, recent role-change events, and the lease issuance audit. We can provide a small CSV mapping `service_account,role,granted_at,actor`.
Alex (SRE): On vuln triage — they asked about CVE process/timeframes. Our process: triage within 1 business day, classification + mitigation plan within 5 business days, and patch/rollback timeline depends on severity. Include link to internal runbook.
Sam (Eng): Also call out mitigations we can do while patching: temporary routing to fallback models, rate-limits, IP allowlists (for Private), and feature flags for rapid cutoff.
Maria (Solutions): For the call: Elaine + Jordan + Alex should join. Sam optional. I'll send calendar invite and attach the current questionnaire — they added a new Q about ephemeral API tokens TTLs.
Elaine (Sec): Quick Q: what are the token TTLs? Session tokens default 1h; SDK ephemeral API tokens 15m with refresh. For service-to-service ephemeral credentials we support 5m-1h depending on scope.
Jordan (Infra): :thumbsup: I'll add exact TTL numbers and the issuance flow diagram to the draft evidence doc.
Alex (SRE): If they ask about proof of key destruction: we can provide KMS key state change logs (DESTROY_SCHEDULED, DESTROYED) and HSM attestation certs for on-prem / air-gapped deployments.
Maria (Solutions): Great. Goal: first-draft evidence bundle by EOD today. Mark all documents CONFIDENTIAL — Customer Acme.
Elaine (Sec): Working on the KMS + RBAC snippets now. Will ping here when ready for review.
sec-bot: Reminder — attach the questionnaire PDF when posting the bundle.
